notes: Printed 3-3-3 New Brunswick Medicare card. PaddleOCR reads the two 3-digit groups merged into one, printing as 6-3 ("999999 999"); OCR also drops "New" from "New Brunswick" (reads as "T Bruwic"), so the finding is reached via the "Medicare" health keyword, not the province name. Real image, not committed to git; lives in the external DEMO folder alongside NB_medicare.png. See docs/evidence/before_after_nb.py output for the before/after detector comparison.
